Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, w As Window
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set w = ActiveWindow
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = w.DisplayOutline & " " & w.DisplayRuler & " " & w.DisplayWhitespace & " " & w.GridlineColor & " " & w.GridlineColorIndex & " " & w.WindowNumber & " " & w.Type & " " & w.AutoFilterDateGrouping
    Case 1
        w.DisplayOutline = False
        w.DisplayRuler = False
        w.DisplayWhitespace = False
        Tried = w.DisplayOutline & " " & w.DisplayRuler & " " & w.DisplayWhitespace
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\flags.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        w.GridlineColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        Tried = w.GridlineColor & " " & w.GridlineColorIndex
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\red.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 3
        w.GridlineColor = RGB(10, 200, 30)
        Tried = w.GridlineColor & " " & w.GridlineColorIndex
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\green.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 4
        w.GridlineColorIndex = 5
        Tried = w.GridlineColor & " " & w.GridlineColorIndex
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\index.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 5
        w.GridlineColorIndex = 5
        w.GridlineColorIndex = xlColorIndexAutomatic
        Tried = w.GridlineColor & " " & w.GridlineColorIndex
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\automatic.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 6
        w.GridlineColorIndex = 0
        Tried = w.GridlineColorIndex
    Case 7
        w.GridlineColorIndex = 57
        Tried = w.GridlineColorIndex
    Case 8
        w.GridlineColorIndex = xlColorIndexNone
        Tried = w.GridlineColorIndex
    Case 9
        w.GridlineColor = -1
        Tried = w.GridlineColor
    Case 10
        w.GridlineColor = 16777216
        Tried = w.GridlineColor
    Case 11
        w.DisplayOutline = "x"
        Tried = w.DisplayOutline
    Case 12
        w.SmallScroll Down:=3
        Tried = w.ScrollRow & " " & w.ScrollColumn
    Case 13
        w.SmallScroll Down:=3
        w.SmallScroll Up:=10
        Tried = w.ScrollRow & " " & w.ScrollColumn
    Case 14
        w.SmallScroll ToRight:=2
        Tried = w.ScrollRow & " " & w.ScrollColumn
    Case 15
        w.SmallScroll Down:=5, Up:=2, ToRight:=4, ToLeft:=1
        Tried = w.ScrollRow & " " & w.ScrollColumn
    Case 16
        w.SmallScroll Down:=-2
        Tried = w.ScrollRow
    Case 17
        w.SmallScroll Down:=2.6
        Tried = w.ScrollRow
    Case 18
        w.SmallScroll Down:="x"
        Tried = w.ScrollRow
    Case 19
        w.ScrollRow = 1048575
        w.SmallScroll Down:=5
        Tried = w.ScrollRow
    Case 20
        w.SmallScroll
        Tried = w.ScrollRow & " " & w.ScrollColumn
    Case 21
        Dim v As Variant
        v = w.SmallScroll(Down:=1)
        Tried = TypeName(v)
    Case 22
        ActiveSheet.Range("A1:A3").Rows.Group
        w.DisplayOutline = False
        Tried = w.DisplayOutline
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\grouped.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 23
        w.DisplayOutline = False
        ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
        Set w = ActiveWindow
        Tried = w.DisplayOutline
    Case 24
        w.DisplayOutline = False
        ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
        ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(2).Activate
        Tried = w.DisplayOutline
    Case 25
        w.GridlineColorIndex = 3
        ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
        Tried = w.GridlineColorIndex
    Case 26
        w.AutoFilterDateGrouping = False
        Tried = w.AutoFilterDateGrouping
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\dates.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 27
        w.AutoFilterDateGrouping = False
        ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
        Tried = ActiveWindow.AutoFilterDateGrouping
    Case 28
        w.AutoFilterDateGrouping = "x"
        Tried = w.AutoFilterDateGrouping
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 28
        s = s & "|" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
